why: The 3 x 3 window slides one column at a time, so instead of recounting nine cells, add the entering column's three digits and remove the leaving column's three. A running count array for digits 1-9 plus a count of distinct digits answers each position in O(1).
hints: Moving the window one step right changes only two columns. What do you need to remember about the current window?
Keep counts[1..9] and the number of digits with a non-zero count. A window is valid when that number is 9 (nine cells, nine distinct digits means each appears once).
Add column c; once c >= 2, record distinct == 9 and remove column c - 2. O(n) overall (the brute force O(9n) also passes).
pitfalls: The result has n - 2 entries, one per window position, not n.
Checking only that the sum is 45 is wrong: 1+2+...+9 can be matched by other multisets (e.g. two 5s instead of 4 and 6).
Remove the leftmost column after recording the answer, not before.
